sources.scope: 127 valid, distinct municipal Lote references verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells at the separately identified central Vitória reference [-20.3155,-40.3128]. The unchanged WUP locator has no exact-point parcel. Complete object-ID manifests, 31-row forced three-row paging over eleven geometry pages, all 127 fresh composite codGeo/codLote identities, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed in 21 checks. Native EPSG:31984 re-reads confirm four tiny source boundary-sliver pairs totaling 0.37279 m²; the largest pair is 0.17233 m², the largest fraction is 0.03197% of the smaller parcel, and overlap-part inscribed diameters are 0.00092–0.01331 m (GEOS tolerance 0.0001 m). Root accepts these documented narrow slivers for bounded reference use, consistent with the Philadelphia review. All original coordinates remain unchanged; no repair, clipping, snapping or selective deletion. Citywide completeness, source-wide identity uniqueness, survey accuracy and legal-title extent remain unverified.
